\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 157-160 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R165-first-pass-words-from-chapters-157-160}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for sandesh and a paratha.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a place, a pavement, a corner, a canal, a zoo
  \item a graveyard, a palace, a fort, a minaret, a ceiling
  \item so, since, if, yet, otherwise
  \item intelligent, hardworking, greedy, worried, elderly
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A place? (\textbf{\bn{জায়গা}}, \emph{jāygā}.) A pavement? (\textbf{\bn{ফুটপাত}}, \emph{phuṭpāt}.) A corner? (\textbf{\bn{মোড়}}, \emph{moṛ}.) A canal? (\textbf{\bn{খাল}}, \emph{khāl}.) A zoo? (\textbf{\bn{চিড়িয়াখানা}}, \emph{chiṛiyākhānā}.) A graveyard? (\textbf{\bn{কবরস্থান}}, \emph{kôbôrsthān}.) A palace? (\textbf{\bn{প্রাসাদ}}, \emph{prāsād}.) A fort? (\textbf{\bn{দুর্গ}}, \emph{durgô}.) A minaret? (\textbf{\bn{মিনার}}, \emph{minār}.) A ceiling? (\textbf{\bn{সিলিং}}, \emph{siling}.) So? (\textbf{\bn{তাই}}, \emph{tāi}.) Since? (\textbf{\bn{যেহেতু}}, \emph{jehetu}.) If? (\textbf{\bn{যদি}}, \emph{jôdi}.) Yet? (\textbf{\bn{তবু}}, \emph{tôbu}.) Otherwise? (\textbf{\bn{নাহলে}}, \emph{nāhôle}.) Intelligent? (\textbf{\bn{বুদ্ধিমান}}, \emph{buddhimān}.) Hardworking? (\textbf{\bn{পরিশ্রমী}}, \emph{pôrishrômī}.) Greedy? (\textbf{\bn{লোভী}}, \emph{lobhī}.) Worried? (\textbf{\bn{চিন্তিত}}, \emph{chintitô}.) Elderly? (\textbf{\bn{বুড়ো}}, \emph{buṛo}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

Polite? (\textbf{\bn{ভদ্র}}, \emph{bhôdrô}.) Gentle? (\textbf{\bn{কোমল}}, \emph{komôl}.) Strict; strong? (\textbf{\bn{কড়া}}, \emph{kôṛā}.) Contented? (\textbf{\bn{সুখী}}, \emph{sukhī}.) Annoyed? (\textbf{\bn{বিরক্ত}}, \emph{birôktô}.) Fragrant? (\textbf{\bn{সুগন্ধি}}, \emph{sugôndhi}.) Rotten? (\textbf{\bn{পচা}}, \emph{pôchā}.) Half? (\textbf{\bn{আধা}}, \emph{ādhā}.) Whole? (\textbf{\bn{পুরো}}, \emph{puro}.) Slight? (\textbf{\bn{সামান্য}}, \emph{sāmānyô}.) Luggage? (\textbf{\bn{মালপত্র}}, \emph{mālpôtrô}.) Furniture? (\textbf{\bn{আসবাব}}, \emph{āsbāb}.) Shampoo? (\textbf{\bn{শ্যাম্পু}}, \emph{shæmpu}.) A towel? (\textbf{\bn{তোয়ালে}}, \emph{toyāle}.) Toothpaste? (\textbf{\bn{টুথপেস্ট}}, \emph{ṭuthpesṭ}.) A file? (\textbf{\bn{ফাইল}}, \emph{phāil}.) Clothes? (\textbf{\bn{পোশাক}}, \emph{poshāk}.) Jeans? (\textbf{\bn{জিনস}}, \emph{jins}.) Shorts? (\textbf{\bn{হাফপ্যান্ট}}, \emph{hāphpænṭ}.) A sweater? (\textbf{\bn{সোয়েটার}}, \emph{soyeṭār}.) A raisin? (\textbf{\bn{কিশমিশ}}, \emph{kishmish}.) Jam? (\textbf{\bn{জ্যাম}}, \emph{jæm}.) A cake? (\textbf{\bn{কেক}}, \emph{kek}.) Sandesh? (\textbf{\bn{সন্দেশ}}, \emph{sôndesh}.) A paratha? (\textbf{\bn{পরোটা}}, \emph{pôroṭā}.)
